actions.description: Generate embeddings for multiple text contents in a single request.
actions.name: batch-embed-contents

model.description: The embedding model to use. Defaults to "gemini-embedding-001".
Model name. Must match the outer model. Defaults to the outer model.

taskType.description: Optional task type for the embedding.

embeddings.description: The embeddings for each request, in the same order as provided in the batch request.

actions.description: Count tokens for a given request without generating a response.
actions.name: count-tokens

totalTokens.description: Total number of tokens in the input.

actions.description: Delete an uploaded file from the Gemini Files API.
actions.name: delete-file

actions.description: Generate a single embedding vector for text content.
actions.name: embed-content

model.description: The embedding model name. Defaults to gemini-embedding-001.

taskType.description: The task type for which the embeddings will be used.

title.description: An optional title for the text. Only applicable when taskType is RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT.

outputDimensionality.description: Reduced dimension for the output embedding. If set, excessive values are truncated from the end.

actions.description: Generate content using a Gemini model with optional system instructions, tools, and generation config.
actions.name: generate-content

actions.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific uploaded file.
actions.name: get-file

name.description: The name of the file to retrieve. Example: "files/abc123"

actions.description: Retrieve a specific Gemini model by name.
actions.name: get-model

actions.description: List cached content entries (context cache) with pagination.
actions.name: list-cached-contents

pageSize.description: The maximum number of cached contents to return. Maximum is 1000.

pageToken.description: A page token from a previous cachedContents.list call to retrieve the subsequent page.

actions.description: List files uploaded to the Gemini Files API.
actions.name: list-files

pageSize.description: Maximum number of files to return per page. Defaults to 10, maximum is 100.

pageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous list-files call. Omit for the first page.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

actions.description: List available Gemini models with pagination.
actions.name: list-models

pageSize.description: Maximum number of models to return per page. Example: 10

pageToken.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.
